**🔮 The Verdict:**  
*Worthy of my Chuba* defeats *Amon Ra Akbar*, 130.4 to 118.4, driven by the higher ceiling of Drake Maye’s dual‑threat potential and the depth of veteran RB production that outpaces Amon Ra Akbar’s reliance on a single elite quarterback.
